name: PunisherWatchlist
description: Adds eye buttons to movies, series, and episodes plus a personal Watchlist tab on the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Prevents the Watchlist item provider from leaking into normal Jellyfin library pages during navigation. Library queries now remain untouched unless the current URL is the dedicated Watchlist route, so all configured library items continue loading and scrolling normally.
Fixes the mobile card controls: the Watchlist eye now stays icon-sized, no longer overlaps Jellyfin's play button, remains transparent, and moves into Jellyfin's native action row when it appears.
